news.title: Most U.S. adults have lived with a romantic partner they’re not married to by their early 40s
news.summary_en: Around three-quarters of Americans in their late 30s or early 40s have lived with a romantic partner they’re not married to at some point in their lives.

news.title: Most Americans are uncomfortable with transgender athletes on sports teams that don’t match their birth sex
news.summary_en: Most Americans are not comfortable with transgender athletes competing on teams that don’t match their birth sex.
